title: Beginners' Spanish I
description: Introduction to Spanish for students with no previous knowledge of Spanish. Acquisition of language and intercultural competencies equivalent to the A1.1 level of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of SPAN 100A, SPAN 100, SPAN 149.
Not open to students with credit in Spanish 12. Not open to native or near-native speakers of Spanish.
